stem:
Tanya notices many adolescent changes, including menstruation and other signs of puberty.

Which statement is correct?

options.text: Many adolescent changes, including menstruation and other puberty signs, are mainly caused and regulated by hormones produced in the body.
Menstruation produces the hormones that start puberty.
Every change during adolescence, including choosing new friends, is mainly caused by hormones.
Menstruation is caused mainly by a wound inside the body.

teacher.key_rationale: Hormones mainly cause and regulate many puberty changes including menstruation. Menstruation does not produce the initiating hormones; not every social choice is mainly hormonal; bleeding is not evidence of a wound.
